[Story]
Zhang Hong and Kai Zhi are childhood friends. When Zhang Hong notices that Kai Zhi only plays with his friends in the team recently, the time he spends with her decreases.

[Question]
She should feel abandoned, but she shows guilt, why?

[Candidate Answers]

B. Zhang Hong always refuses to go out with Kai Zhi because of academic pressure recently, she thinks she causes their estrangement.
C. Kai Zhi knows that he spends less time with Zhang Hong recently, so he makes a gift for her by hand and says he always is her best friend.
D. Zhang Hong thinks she does not cherish the friendship with Kai Zhi, because she focuses too much on her own things before.
